mapper.select: select CONFIG_ID configId, YES_OR_NO yesOrNo, LAST_PERIOD_PRI lastPeriodPri, SEC_GRADE_PRI secGradePri from ETR_SEC_PRIORITY where LIMIT 1

SELECT TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, TABLE01.FINPROD_ID finprodId,
IFNULL(TABLE01.AMOUNT,0) * 100 avaPledgePrin, IFNULL(TABLE01.AMOUNT,0) * 100 pledgePrin, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, IFNULL(MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.LAST_PERIOD,0) lastPeriod, ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.SCALE pledgeRatio, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_6 windTypeOne, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_7 windTypeTwo, (CASE WHEN ETR_SEC_PRIORITY.YES_OR_NO='Y' THEN IFNULL(ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL.pledge_pri,'03') ELSE '03' END) pledgePri,/*质押优先级，未启用或未设置则为 03中*/ IFNULL(FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR,FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME) bondAbbrName, FIN_PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode
FROM ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID, TEMP.BRANCH, SUM(TEMP.AMOUNT) AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION.FINPROD_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION.BRANCH, CASE WHEN PTL_SEC_POSITION.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_03},#{POSITION_TYPE_05},#{POSITION_TYPE_08})then PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT ELSE -1 * PTL_SEC_POSITION.AMOUNT END as AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE 1=1 AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_03}, #{POSITION_TYPE_04},#{POSITION_TYPE_05}, #{POSITION_TYPE_06},#{POSITION_TYPE_08},#{POSITION_TYPE_11})
UNION ALL SELECT PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.SEC_ACCT_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.FINPROD_ID, PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.BRANCH, CASE WHEN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01})then PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.AMOUNT ELSE -1 * PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.AMOUNT END as AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW WHERE 1=1 AND PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01}, #{POSITION_TYPE_12}) ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.BRANCH HAVING SUM(TEMP.AMOUNT) > 0 )TABLE01 ON ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID = TABLE01.FINPROD_ID AND ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.BRANCH = TABLE01.BRANCH AND ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TABLE01.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ON FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID = ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL ON FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.type_6 = ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL.windtypeone AND ( ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL.windtypetwo IS NULL OR FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE.type_7 = ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL.windtypetwo ) LEFT JOIN ETR_SEC_PRIORITY ON ETR_SEC_PRIORITY_DETAIL.CONFIG_ID = ETR_SEC_PRIORITY.CONFIG_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.LAST_PERIOD, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND tmp1.value_source = (CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID
WHERE 1=1
AND FIN_PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET IN (#{TRADEPLACE01},#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04})
AND ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
